original_query: Create a bar chart to compare the composite deprivation scores (Column B) across different Unitary Authorities (Column A) in the South East region.
optimized_code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Rename columns for easier access
column_mapping = {
    'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived)': 'Unitary Authority',
    'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).1': 'Composite Deprivation Score'
}
df.rename(columns=column_mapping, inplace=True)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.bar(df['Unitary Authority'], df['Composite Deprivation Score'])
plt.title('Composite Deprivation Scores by Unitary Authority')
plt.xlabel('Unitary Authority')
plt.ylabel('Composite Deprivation Score')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
#Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Unitary Authority', 'y_fields': ['Composite Deprivation Score'], 'chart_type': 'barChart'}
plt.show()
